en: The image is a black-and-white vintage-style postcard showing a panoramic view of a city at the foot of a mountain. In the foreground, there is a large open square or field with several groups of people, possibly soldiers or civilians, standing in formation. The background displays a densely built area with several multi-story buildings and houses climbing up the hillside. Trees frame the image on the right and at the top. The text in the upper left reads 'Trento. Piazza d’armi.'
